name: Chougen Yuuki: Mugenfinity
original_name: 超限勇希 ムゲンフィニティ
source:
Eight years ago, the Voldan tried to invade the world, but were repelled by one man who risked his life for the future of the world. His name was Touma and he piloted a robot with the help of a young boy and a masked girl. After this incident, he left the world to fight other enemies. The young boy, Tamaki, was viewed as his successor, but he soon lost his powers with age. Now no one remembers him until he meets ‘him’ and ‘her’ and the story begins once again.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/09/01/september-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
八年前，沃爾丹企圖入侵世界，卻被一名為世界未來賭上性命的男子擊退。他名叫冬馬，在一名少年和一名蒙面少女的幫助下駕駛機器人作戰。事件結束後，他離開這個世界，前往對抗其他敵人。那名少年環被視為他的繼承人，卻隨著年齡增長很快失去了力量。如今已經無人記得他，直到他遇見「他」與「她」，故事再度開始。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/09/01/september-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
